title.id: Artikel baru: Model AI Raksasa di RAM Biasa dan Aturan Privasi Data
title.en: New article: Running Massive AI on Standard RAM and Data Compliance Needs

body.id: Satu tulisan baru ditambahkan ke blog: "Model AI Raksasa di RAM Biasa dan Aturan Privasi Data". Tulisannya membahas eksperimen menjalankan model 284b tanpa gpu membuka opsi komputasi lokal bagi pengembang lokal yang terikat aturan data pribadi
body.en: A new article was added to the blog: "Running Massive AI on Standard RAM and Data Compliance Needs". It covers techniques that fit huge parameter models into ordinary memory offer a compliant path for local teams facing strict data privacy laws
